row.title: Unlearn tells famous-finding-retold stories by itself and gives readers a reason to come back daily
row.body: Rowan wants far more narrative-vs-later-evidence entries, automated, and a sticky site that runs a year unattended. Decision: a retold topic with then/now timelines graded honestly; a second daily discovery search for replications and re-analyses; drafts reach their own page only after reader votes and only with an index citation, always labelled a draft from one paper; a myth of the day cycle, an Atom feed and a browser-only streak bring readers back without accounts or cookies.

title: Unlearn tells famous-finding-retold stories by itself and gives readers a reason to come back daily
